blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — A public school teacher and proud Alangan Mangyan from Naujan town was named one of the 2026 Metrobank Foundation Outstanding Filipinos and was formally recognized by President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. in ceremonies at Malacañang Palace on Tuesday. Dr. Emmanuel D. Guarde, Master Teacher II at Cornelio Lintawagin Memorial Elementary School, was cited as a “steward of indigenous knowledge and heritage” for developing culturally rooted learning materials that honor the identity of indigenous learners. His milestone project, “Baren: An Indigenous Lullaby of Learning — Nurturing Mangyan Education Through Culture-Based Teaching,” introduces a localized alphabet, indigenous stories, […]...
